Old Trafford growing impatient with how slowly United are moving the ball, a lack of options for the player in possession and they are being caught on it repeatedly by a sharp Brighton team.

Sources indicate that diego Gomez really should have sealed the victory, picked out by another clever Gross pass, but with so much time to take aim he blasted straight at Darlow. United still alive in the tie, but only just.

According to recent reports, lovely Brighton interplay again, Gross just keeps making the right decision around the box. This time his cut-back finds Kostoulas but Yoro blocks his goal-bound shot. Now Brighton make their fifth change: Rutter replaces Kostoulas.

Brighton still swinging punches. Costinha swings in a teasing cross to the back post, headed down by Gross, but De Cuyper cannot get over his volley. Carrick has made his final change: Cunha is on for Rashford.

Industry observers note that massive miss by Rashford, but a big save from Jason Steele. It was a lovely touch by Fernandes while half stumbling that released Rashford, and he had so much time to think when through against the goalkeeper, but Steele stuck out a right boot to save.

Hurzeler making two more Brighton changes: Ayari and Kadioglu on for Hadjam and Boscagli, which probably makes their XI on the pitch even stronger. Kadioglu was voted Brighton’s player of the season for 2025-26.

Recent findings suggest that bruno Fernandes is stripped and ready to come on, Carrick calling for the man he would rather was resting on the bench. Fernandes replaces Mount.

According to recent reports, de Cuyper, only on for a few minutes, scores the goal, but it was the off-the-shoulder threat of Kostoulas that made the goal. It looked as if the striker had the ball stuck under his feet, but he squeezed in a low cross that deflected off Mazraoui into the path of De Cuyper who had the simplest of finishes.

Brighton have turned it around!!! 🔵A sensational comeback as Maxim De Cuyper makes it 3-2 at Old Trafford. pic.twitter.com/Bfcr4N7mTL.

Changes all round: Mainoo, Mbeumo and Zirkzee replace Sesko, Lacey and Andrey Santos.

For Brighton: De Cuyper and Diego Gomez on for Yalouye and Matt O’Riley.

In a recent development, he has been the scourge of United on so many occasions, and so it has proved again. United tried to play out from deep against Brighton’s press, hooked a longer pass around the corner towards Sesko but Vuskovic nipped in front of him to win a booming header back to Gross at the edge of the box. Nice touch to shift the ball left, before finishing across Darlow.

Pascal Gross takes advantage of a gifted opportunity to level the score! 🔥 pic.twitter.com/Qu2E0B6060.

It has been revealed that short corner from United after good work from Rashford, but Tielemans could not keep his curling shot under the bar. Brighton break, but it is better defending from Heaven against Kostoulas this time. Carrick is preparing a triple sub.

According to recent reports, sesko with space to drive forward and look to pass or shot, but he dallies and dawdles before losing possession, much to the frustration of Old Trafford. Sesko has looked short of sharpness and confidence so far.

Delicious pieces of skill from Lacey, a Cruyff turn against the touchline when he was facing away from goal. Hadjam thought he had the winger boxed in, and dragged him down at the expense of a yellow card. Crowd enjoyed that.

Vuskovic with a shot from distance which is always rising; a number of Brighton players have tried their luck from range tonight, perhaps inspired by Lewis Dunk’s screamer at Coventry. This second half has a been a bit of a non-event thus far.

Matt O’Riley clips Heaven, which enabled the United defender to get out jail because he did not have control of the ball and was scrambling. Then Struijk very nearly sells Steele short with a back pass, had Sesko have won the first touch it was a red card or a goal, but Steele went to ground to win the ball well outside his area.

It has been revealed that rashford has been a bright spark for United, but he is having to do too much of the heavy lifting on his own at the moment. This time he finds Lacey on the overlap, but his cross is volleyed clear. Moments before that, the Old Trafford crowd were unhappy that Lacey was not awarded a free-kick. Looked like Hadjam took a swipe.

Industry observers note that brighton continue to apply the squeeze, but Kostoulas fouls Mazraoui to enable Darlow to boot the ball long and United to push up the pitch. Carrick’s team are still not exerting much control on the contest, though.

United kick off in the second half.

That is something of a rarity at this stage of the League Cup.

Industry observers note that plenty of entertainment for the paying punters at Old Trafford, with Shea Lacey and Mason Mount scoring twice in two minutes to put United in a commanding position. Given the JJ Gabriel story, the home fans enjoyed seeing a 19-year-old kiss the badge after scoring on his full debut.

Brighton have probably been the better team in general play though, and scored a deserved goal on the stroke of half-time.

United’s second-string back four looking very shaky, understandably.

According to recent reports, carrick and United wanted a foul on Sesko on halfway, but the referee mentioned nothing doing. Hadjam then floats a diagonal pass over the head of Heaven to find the run of Kostoulas, but goalkeeper Darlow surely had the chance to come off his line and claim? Passive goalkeeping, and Kostoulas slips the ball under Darlow into the far corner. Game on.

Industry observers note that kostoulas halves the deficit! 🔵Brighton score on the stroke of half-time. pic.twitter.com/bGjN1w6s6c.

Chema Andres, signed by Brighton from Stuttgart on deadline day and known by the moniker “Baby Rodri”, has just been booked for a reckless challenge in midfield. Then Rashford indicates he still has plenty in the locker with a touch and shimmy to beat Costinha.

According to recent reports, tielemans with an important challenge on Kostoulas, after more unconvincing United involving Dalot misjudging a bouncing ball. Then Kostoulas fizzes a cross all the way through the six-yard box and Gross fires over at the back post. Brighton have had the chances to be level.

Yalcouye was very dangerous for Brighton against Coventry, and he is proving difficult to contain again. Gross’s through ball releases him into space behind Dalot, but his side-footed shot was shoved wide of the post. He tried to “Henry” one around Darlow with his right instep and failed to find the curl.

Clean hit from almost 35 yards from Boscagli, but his left-footed attempt whistles just over the bar. Yoro heads away a temping Gross cross when Brighton had three blue shirts in promising positions. Rashford then puts the ball through the legs of Chema Andres, and United have a corner.

Lacey goes down hoping for free-kick, anticipating the contact from Gross but it was not forthcoming. Since 2013-14, United have been 2-0 up at Old Trafford 145 times, winning 143 and drawing just two.

In a recent development, brighton well on top now, and Ayden Heaven goes to ground hoping for a free-kick but the referee is having none of it. O’Riley’s cross is turned behind for a corner, which United scramble away. Feels like a Brighton goal is on the way, despite the comfortable scoreline for United.

Brighton’s corner swung in from the right was far too deep and loopy, drifting harmlessly behind for a United goal kick. Brighton are soon back on the front foot, and Gross picks out Kostoulas in the middle but the forward’s touch let him down. Edgy defending from Yoro but United clear their lines eventually.

Mazraoui is now back on the pitch but he does not look 100 per cent. Brighton enjoying some long passages of possession now, but you sense United are happy to drop off and let them have the ball. More promising build-up play ends with Mazraoui heading a cross over the bar for a Brighton corner.

There has been a lengthy stoppage in play while Mazraoui receives treatment for a bang on the head. United’s left-back looks a little shaken and is off the pitch now, and Mason Mount has dropped into the left-back position.

Recent findings suggest that sesko and Vuskovic are enjoying a good battle early on. Andrey Santos then sells Tielemans a little short in midfield and Brighton take advantage, but O’Riley does not have the pace to get away from Mazraoui.

Recent findings suggest that there are usually chances at both ends when Brighton are involved and so it has proved so far. A pleasant surprise for any Manchester United fans who feared the worst arriving at Old Trafford tonight.

Shea Lacey is the first teenager to score on their full Man Utd debut since Marcus Rashford back in 2016. And they even got to celebrate together 🥺 pic.twitter.com/hBeXpCr4Tc.

Sources indicate that brighton playing their way into trouble in their own defensive third, and it is great work from Rashford to drive into the penalty area from the left. Steele makes a save with his feet, but the ball runs kindly for Mount to power his shot into the ground and into the roof of the net.

It has been revealed that mason Mount DOUBLES Man Utd's lead! 🤩 pic.twitter.com/c83ggCb8Bf.

The 19-year-old, sent off against Brighton in the FA Cup last season, has powered a left-footed shot from the edge of the box beyond Steele. That is a moment to lift the Old Trafford crowd.

Sources indicate that SHEA LACEY ON HIS FIRST START!!! 🔴🌟What a hit from the 19-year-old to open the scoring for Man Utd! pic.twitter.com/Ex2ceXaUge.

Really slick, one-touch football from Brighton through midfield, players bumping off passes blind around the corner knowing their team-mate has read the next move, but the move breaks down at the edge of the box. Brighton tend to have plenty of possession and they have made a confident start. Boscagli then tries to chip Darlow from about 70 yards but it was never really on.

Recent findings suggest that some sound early defending from Brighton right-back Constinha, just when it looked like Rashford was going to break into space down the left flank. Yalcouye with a flick around the corner in midfield but his touch gets away from him and he commits a foul.

Then Yalcouye’s directness causes Yoro a problem near the left touchline, with the French defender hacking him down.

We are under way at Old Trafford.

Tonight promises to be a test for Ayden Heaven and Leny Yoro who are a young centre-back partnership for United. Looks a good crowd for a third-round League Cup game.

Meanwhile, some interesting news on JJ Gabriel’s future from our man at Old Trafford:.

Barcelona are leading the race for JJ Gabriel after the 15-year-old requested to quit Manchester United.

Telegraph Sport revealed this week that Gabriel has told the club he wants to cancel his registration and move as a free agent, with Europe’s biggest club well aware of the teenager.

Gabriel travelled to Barcelona last season when he was shown around their training ground and met Wojciech Szczesny and club legend Sergio Busquets.

Sources at rival Premier League suitors believe that Barça have stolen a march in the race for the England Under-17 forward.

Should he move abroad, United may only get around £300,000 in training compensation as Gabriel has a European Union passport.

United would be expected to look into whether there was any influence from football agents before September 1 when Gabriel was allowed to have a representative.

It has been revealed that they are the Premier League’s top scorers with 13 goals in four games and they also lead the division when it comes to expected goals amassed. Brighton have also won four of their last five visits to Old Trafford in all competitions.

Sources indicate that we’ve got the squad to do it, we feel its important and the boys are desperate to play. We’ve got a very good team out.

We’ve moved on [from the Manchester derby]. On the day, you have to deal with it, I think there’s been enough stated about it [the VAR decision] and we move on.

They’re a very good team, the way they play, you make you work for it, we’ll be ready for that. They play some very good football, and score an awful lot of goals.

It has been revealed that youri Tielemans has been given the armband for the evening in an interesting Manchester United line-up named by Michael Carrick. Karl Darlow gets his club debut and Mason Mount is back from injury. Shea Lacey gets a start too, a home-grown talent given his chance in the week JJ Gabriel, 15, has requested to leave Old Trafford.

Eight changes by Carrick, with Karl Darlow between the sticks. Mazraoui, Yoro, Heaven, Andrey Santos, Mount, Sesko and Lacey the other players to come in. No JJ Gabriel in the squad.

United starting XI: Darlow; Dalot, Yoro, Heaven, Mazraoui; Santos, Tielemans; Lacey, Mount, Rashford; Sesko.

Subs: Lammens, Maguire, Amass, Fernandes, Mainoo, T Fletcher, Cunha, Zirkzee, Mbeumo.

Representing United this evening... 🥁🏆.

Lewis Steele replaces Bart Verbruggen in goal, and O’Riley, Costinha, O’Riley, Chema and Hadjam are the other players to come in. With the Conference League not starting until after the international break, Brighton do not have a pressing need to rotate.

Brighton XI: Steele, Costinha Vuskovic, Struijk, Boscagli, Chema, Gross, O’Reilly, Yalcouye, Hadjam, Kostoulas.

Subs: Verbruggen, Dunk, Georginio, Promise, Osman, Kadioglu, Gomez, Ayari, De Cuyper.

Sources indicate that TEAM NEWS! 🚨 Our starting XI for #MUNBHA. 👊 pic.twitter.com/gK5tUVYJ7L.

Talents like Gabriel offer United fans hope of a brighter future after years of failure and underachievement.

In a recent development, no one can be certain he will fulfil the vast potential everyone in football circles can see. But United would love to have a good stab at helping him realise it.

The notion of him doing it somewhere else will send chills down the spines of the Old Trafford hierarchy.

Here are the numbers. Man City vs Norwich is tomorrow night, so their last-16 tie will be clarified then. Spurs, Leeds and Forest three Premier League teams who have already fallen by the wayside.

The joke goes that Michael Carrick has already bettered Ruben Amorim’s efforts by reaching the third round of the League Cup, but Manchester United will need to find a way past free-flowing Brighton if they are to go any further.

United were eliminated in the second round by League Two Grimsby Town last season, but start the competition a stage later because they are one of nine Premier League clubs playing in European competition.

Brighton knocked United out of the FA Cup in the third round, with Danny Welbeck scoring at Old Trafford, meaning the club played just 40 matches in 2025-26.

Carrick will want to make a better fist of the cup competitions, but he could really use a win of any kind after taking just four points from United’s first four league games of the new season.

The no-show at Hull and derby defeat by City’s 10 men were especially dispiriting, and the relationship between the club and supporters is becoming increasingly strained.

Sources indicate that there were no flags on the Stretford End for the game against City, as fans voiced their opposition to what they view as a heavy-handed ticketing policy. The club states the measures are to stop ticket-touting but critics believe many innocent season-ticket holders are being caught in the crossfire and having their tickets revoked.

Discontent is never too far away given the continued presence of the Glazer family, and confidence is fragile regarding the club’s sporting direction under Sir Jim Ratcliffe and Ineos.

It has been revealed that the news that 15-year-old JJ Gabriel, possibly the country’s outstanding academy player in his year group, wants out (broken by Matt Law in a Telegraph Sport exclusive) nagged at some of those fears. Gabriel could have been in contention for a place on the bench this evening, but that is now surely out of the question even if United say they have not given up hope of persuading him to stay.Full team news on the way shortly.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Il Napoli Primavera non va oltre l’1 a 1 casalingo contro il Perugia. Al termine del match ha parlato il tecnico della Primavera Antonio Nocerino, ecco le sue dichiarazioni:.

Recent findings suggest that “Abbiamo fatto una buona gara, ma ci sono cose che a me non piacciono. Mi aspetto pochi errori e che non si sbaglia dalla gente tecnica, troppi errori nell’ultimo passaggio. La prestazione è buona, i ragazzi sono stati bravissimo, noi ieri l’abbiamo preparata che tanti erano in prima squadra. Abbiamo giocato contro una squadra che ha i punti che merita e gioca molto bene. Se andiamo a vedere la partita sono rammaricato, mi sono intristito, hai tante opportunità e non chiudi la partita, poi vabbè il rigore..sono cose che ci possono stare”.

It has been revealed that sulla fase difensiva: “Andando spesso uomo contro uomo, noi lavoriamo tanto sul doppio lavoro, cercando di mettersi a 1 metro e mezzo dalla distanza, sia per coprire palla nello spazio che essere pronti ad attaccare. Marotta? Al di là dell’espulsione è un giocatore molto importante per noi, dovrebbe essere più lucido nelle situazione di gara, ma questo fa parte della crescita e migliorare nella frenata e non andare di intuito, per portarlo dove vuoi tu. Ogni tanto capita l’errore, fa parte del percorso di questa stagione”.

Industry observers note that su Spinelli e Pereyra in prima squadra: “Sono contento e orgoglioso, vuol dire che il lavoro stanno facendo è giusto. Ma questo non basta, non bisogna accontentarsi, fare sempre qualche cosa in più; andare in prima squadra è bellissimo, poi bisogna farsi trovare pronto per stare più tempo e magari entrare, nel calcio non si può mai sapere”.

Sulla Youth League: “Non siamo ancora come io vorrei, a volte devi accompagnare i ragazzi, che ancora non hanno vissuto il calcio dei grandi, piano piano stiamo cercando di fargli capire che devono essere pronti sempre. Sono bravi ragazzi e avere una mentalità forte li metterà in condizione di affrontare prime squadre. L’obiettivo è dargli autostima e meno negatività, cercando di aiutarli in questo percorso, non lasciarli abbattere. Le cose negative vengono, ma l’importante è reagire e quello è l’obiettivo che noi cerchiamo a livello emotivo”.

It has been revealed that sul Centro Sportivo: “Sicuramente deve alimentare l’entusiasmo, ormai sono tanti anni che vivo fuori e ho visto un pò tutto. A me dispiace è che si deve andare a vedere il negativo, quella cosa che non è costruttiva. Se io ho la possibilità e ho un presidente che cerca di fare qualcosa, io devo essere solo orgoglioso e onorato da napoletano, in modo che i napoletani non debbano andare via e possano avere la fortuna di essere in campi dove prepararsi fisicamente e mentalmente. Ormai quando uno fa c’è sempre qualcosa da dire, per Napoli è qualcosa che fa la differenza. Lo spero soprattutto per i ragazzi e per fargli coltivare il proprio talento. La cosa che mi sta deludendo è la negatività, non si guarda mai a chi vuole fare qualcosa di diverso che crede nella città. Chi non fa alla fine parla, deve solo parlare e buttare via l’aria alla bocca, io preferisco chi fa e alla fine sarà sempre criticato. Si tratta della mentalità italiana, c’è gelosia e invidia di chi vuole successo. A me questo dà fastidio, è un problema culturale, io nel mio piccolo sto cercando di andare avanti e non ascoltare la negatività, chi ti dirà che è facile ti sta mentendo. Mi auguro che il presidente faccia il centro sportivo, avere il centro sportivo è come l’aria”. Ecco il video:.

  • Cosa scatta nella testa di ragazzi come te alla prima esperienza tra i professionisti quando si è chiamati ad affrontare squadre di categoria?
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Scegli FcInter1908 come tuo sito preferito su Google: clicca qui.

Recent findings suggest that mattia Marello, esterno sinistro dell'Inter U23 e autore del primo gol nella vittoria contro il Potenza, ha parlato in conferenza stampa al termine del match: "Sono super contento per la squadra e per il mio gol perché ha contribuito alla vittoria. Sono molto contento della prestazione perché era una gara difficile, contro una squadra che arrivava da un periodo importante, che è a +9 sulla seconda".

Cosa scatta nella testa di ragazzi come te alla prima esperienza tra i professionisti quando si è chiamati ad affrontare squadre di categoria? Cosa vi viene chiesto?

"Venivamo da una settimana difficile, io come tanti altri siamo stati in Nazionale, altri erano con la Prima Squadra, e quindi non siamo riusciti ad allenarci bene. Abbiamo preparato la partita in pochi giorni, ma sono stati molto importanti perché abbiamo fatto gruppo. Il mister ci ha parlato tanto prima e dopo l'allenamento, ci ha detto molto del Potenza insieme al suo staff e l'abbiamo preparata alla grande. Eravamo gasati".

Difficile preparare una gara con l'uscita di GTA?

It has been revealed that "GTA? Non ho la Play Station, non è un mio problema... Magari altri hanno sofferto questo momento, ma non è il mio caso! Sono molto contento per la partita, eravamo gasati anche prima, il mister ci ha fatto un bel discorso e ci ha preparati. Sapevamo che non sarebbe stata una partita come le altre".

In cosa puoi migliorare ancora?

"Parlo sempre tanto con il mister e i suoi collaboratori, lo chiedo anche io. Io cerco di migliorarmi ogni giorno su tutto, anche sulle cose in cui sono più forte, però principalmente cerco di allenare il piede debole e le letture difensive per diventare un calciatore completo".

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By CHRIS WHEELER, NORTHERN SPORTS WRITER.

Published: 11:27 EST, 16 November 2026 | Updated: 13:55 EST, 16 November 2026.

Manchester United have laid on a private jet for Mauricio Pochettino to fly straight to England in the early hours of Wednesday morning after he finishes work as US national team coach.

In a recent development, pochettino’s last game in charge is against Haiti in Cincinnati, which kicks off at midnight on Tuesday UK time. The 54-year-old will speak to the media and say farewell to his players before jumping on a plane to Manchester which has been organised by United.

It will enable Pochettino to sleep before he lands in the UK on Wednesday morning ready to go straight to Carrington and start work.

He will be accompanied by first-team coach Miguel D’Agostino, strength and conditioning coach Silvia Tuya and analyst Alec Scott.

It has emerged that three other members of his trusted coaching team – assistant Jesus Perez, goalkeeper coach Toni Jimenez and his son and fitness coach Sebastiano Pochettino – were allowed to travel to Manchester at the weekend after the US won the first leg against Haiti 6-0 in Miami.

Industry observers note that it means that Pochettino’s back-room staff have been able to make a headstart in their preparations for his first game in charge against Liverpool at Anfield on Sunday. It is a huge fixture in the calendar for United, but even more so because he takes over a team languishing in the relegation zone.

Man United have laid on a private jet for Mauricio Pochettino to fly straight to England after he finishes work as US national team coach.

Pochettino will take charge of his final match as USA boss in Cincinnati before boarding the direct flight to Manchester.

Pochettino's long-time assistant Jesus Perez is one of three trusted staff members who have already been given permission to travel to Manchester.

Pochettino will be able to work with the players as they begin reporting back from international duty, and is expected to speak to club media before conducting his pre-match press conference on Friday lunchtime.

Speaking ahead of the second leg against Haiti at the TQL Stadium, Pochettino noted: ‘I am with Miguel, Sylvia and Alec and after they are going to join me in Manchester.

‘The next question is where are Jesus, Toni and Sebastiano? They are ahead. After the game (in Miami), they flew to Manchester and they are there in advance. That was the plan when we agreed terms with Manchester United and with the US national team.

‘They are there preparing everything because on Wednesday, when we arrive, it’s going to be non-stop and then we start with playing games.’.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Il governatore dice di averne parlato con Tajani e chiede al presidente biancoceleste di misurare il proprio consenso.

It has been revealed that francesco Rocca invita Claudio Lotito a candidarsi con Forza Italia alle comunali di Roma del 2027, per misurare il consenso che saprebbe raccogliere. Secondo quanto riportato da Lacapitale, Il presidente della Regione Lazio rivolge la sfida al senatore e presidente biancoceleste durante «Nexus – Visioni e strategie di sviluppo del territorio», la manifestazione in corso al Palacongressi di Fiuggi, come riferisce La Capitale. Rocca riassume così la sua proposta: «Lotito si candidi a Roma con Forza Italia, così vediamo quanti voti prende, forse qualcuno anche dai romanisti».

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

According to recent reports, rocca, tifoso della Lazio e da tempo critico verso la gestione societaria di Lotito, porta così il confronto anche sul piano politico. Le sue parole non sono un annuncio di candidatura da parte di Lotito né una proposta formalizzata dalla coalizione di centrodestra.

Sources indicate that il governatore chiama in causa il segretario nazionale di Forza Italia, Antonio Tajani, al quale dice di aver già prospettato una candidatura di Lotito nella Capitale. Collega l’ipotesi alla volontà del presidente della Lazio di proseguire la propria attività politica e al ritorno delle preferenze.

«Ho detto al presidente di Forza Italia Antonio Tajani: visto che Lotito si è innamorato della politica, vuole continuare ed è legittimo, e considerato che tornano le preferenze, dovrebbe candidarlo a Roma», afferma Rocca.

According to recent reports, all’invito aggiunge una battuta sulla rivalità tra le due squadre romane: «Così vediamo quante ne prende, forse qualcuna anche dai romanisti». Il punto della sfida, per Rocca, è verificare i voti che Lotito otterrebbe attraverso una candidatura personale.

Il presidente della Regione lega la prova elettorale al ruolo che, a suo giudizio, la Lazio ha avuto nel percorso politico di Lotito. «Questo è il momento della verità per Lotito, per dimostrare che è lui un valore aggiunto per la politica, altrimenti è vero il contrario: è stata la Lazio a portarlo in Senato», sostiene.

Rocca insiste sull’opportunità di cominciare dalle amministrative romane con Forza Italia e richiama anche Reggio Calabria. «Oggi ha la possibilità di dimostrare che la Lazio ha portato tanti consensi a lui e al suo partito. È andato a Reggio Calabria? Si candidasse a Roma, accettasse la sfida, cominciasse già dalle comunali con Forza Italia e vediamo quanto è trascinatore di folle».

According to recent reports, le dichiarazioni si collocano nel confronto politico in vista delle elezioni capitoline del 2027. Restano, però, una sfida lanciata da Rocca a Lotito, non una candidatura annunciata dal presidente biancoceleste.

Lamine Yamal mercilessly taunted England rival Elliot Anderson as tensions flared during the Three Lions’ spectacular victory over Spain on Sunday night.

England held on for a memorable 3-2 victory in Madrid after Anderson was given his marching orders with just under 30 minutes remaining.

Thomas Tuchel’s side were three goals in front and cruising when Anderson - looking to atone for a sloppy error from Jarrel Quansah - cynically hauled down 19-year-old Yamal as he barrelled down on goal.

Spain were awarded a penalty for the infringement, and Anderson was sent off - much to the Manchester City star’s bemusement.

But Yamal, aggrieved by Anderson’s challenge, made a beeline for the midfielder following the challenge. According to Spanish reports, the attacker mouthed ‘tonto, tonto’ to his rival following his dismissal.

The colloquial term can mean a number of things, varying from idiot, fool or stupid, but in any case is far from a term of affection.

Lamine Yamal was spotted taunting Elliot Anderson after the Manchester City midfielder was sent off for a challenge on the winger.

The moment came in England's historic 3-2 win over the World Champions.

Anderson blanked the 19-year-old while a VAR review confirmed the on-field official’s decision was the right one, eventually trudging off the pitch.

A fired-up Yamal galvanised the reigning world champions as they searched for an unlikely comeback.

Mikel Oyarzabal, the man who scored Spain’s winner against England two years ago in the 2024 Euros final, converted the spot kick before Nico Williams scored Spain’s second after latching on to an excellent Yamal cross.

However, Las Rojas fell short, with Sunday’s defeat their first in an imperious 43-game run.

A jubilant Thomas Tuchel hailed the match as his ‘best performance of my time as manager’.

Sources indicate that ‘What a performance we put out there for 60 minutes to be deservedly 3-0 up,’ Tuchel stated after the game. ’Thirty minutes against Spain with ten men feels like three hours.

Recent findings suggest that ‘It was a statement victory. It was on the highest level football-wise. It is a wonderful feeling for us in the dressing room.’.

Dopo la sosta per le Nazionali, il campionato 2026-27 riprende con la dodicesima giornata, in programma dal 21 al 23 novembre 2026. Le due squadre capitoline giocheranno entrambe sabato 21 novembre.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Come riportato da Opta, Lazio e Roma sono rimaste entrambe imbattute nelle prime 11 giornate per la prima volta nella storia delle formazioni romane nella massima serie. Il risultato raggiunto prima della pausa può quindi essere migliorato nel prossimo turno: se nessuna delle due perderà, la serie condivisa salirà a 12 giornate.

Sources indicate that le partite delle due squadre sono concentrate nello spazio di poche ore. Alle 15 la Lazio ospiterà il Lecce all’Olimpico; alle 18 toccherà alla Roma, impegnata sul campo del Parma. Saranno questi i due incontri da cui dipenderà la possibilità di prolungare il primato congiunto.

#49948. Tech Report: Floyd Samba’s Man City debut double has father Chris dancing

Tech Report: Floyd Samba’s Man City debut double has father Chris dancing

📅 17 Sep 2026 | ⏱️ 21 min read (4122 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Co

⏱️ ~21 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • There was very much a Samba beat to this Manchester City victory – and it almost had a famous father in the crowd up dancing.
  • This was a night when Brazilian Allan Elias scored his first goal on an enterprising first appearance for City.
  • But it was another debutant who stole the show as the Carabao Cup holders sailed past Norwich City to set up a fourth-round meeting with Brighton.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

There was very much a Samba beat to this Manchester City victory – and it almost had a famous father in the crowd up dancing.

This was a night when Brazilian Allan Elias scored his first goal on an enterprising first appearance for City.

But it was another debutant who stole the show as the Carabao Cup holders sailed past Norwich City to set up a fourth-round meeting with Brighton.

Floyd Samba scored two fine goals and had a hand in another on a dream debut that had his beaming dad up off his seat and thrusting his arms in the air as if ready to party.

If the Samba surname feels familiar, that is because Floyd’s father Christopher played more than 200 games for Blackburn Rovers, Queens Park Rangers and Aston Villa.

In fact, it was very much a family affair as Floyd’s brothers Tyrone and Emerson, who are also in City’s academy and hoping one day to tread a similar path, joined in the jubilant celebrations alongside their mother, a visibly emotional Theresa.

According to recent reports, this particular evening belonged to Floyd, though. Deployed as a lone striker by Enzo Maresca, you would not have known he ordinarily plays as a midfielder such was the confidence and composure the 17-year-old oozed.

Norwich could not live with him or City for that matter as Maresca’s impressive start as manager since replacing Pep Guardiola continued apace.

According to recent reports, this must have been an incredibly satisfying moment for Samba Sr. He came through incredible hardship – at one stage as a teenager he was rough-sleeping – to forge an impressive career totalling more than 450 games for club and country.

According to recent reports, so to be in a position to now have three sons in City’s academy and one produce a debut like this will fill him with enormous pride. Floyd was later seen enjoying a warm embrace with his dad in the crowd, moments after being congratulated by Tyrone, a year his senior, and 12-year-old Emerson, who plays for City’s Under-13s.

It has been revealed that “I knew there would be an opportunity to get some minutes for the first time with the first team – to get a debut like that is mind blowing,” Samba said. “I couldn’t believe it myself, but that’s just the beginning, I’ve got a significant career ahead of me. It was a great debut.”.

Sources indicate that floyd caught the eye with a fine free-kick in City’s 2-1 FA Youth Cup final victory over Manchester United last season and now he has goals for the senior side to his name. Pretty stunning they were, too.

The first was a superbly steered header past two Norwich bodies on the line from Allan’s cross and the second a lovely, nonchalantly curled finish low into the far corner.

Recent findings suggest that what a moment for Floyd Samba! 😍A goal on his Man City debut for the 17-year-old, son of former Blackburn defender Chris 🩵 pic.twitter.com/VCVfX9HCNn.

In a recent development, chris Samba has deliberately kept a low profile, keen to let his sons get on with their own careers free of distractions, but there was no chance he was going to be able to suppress his emotions in that instant. And nor should he. It was some moment for the boy and his family.

Sources indicate that as impressed as Maresca was by the goals, it will have been other elements of Samba’s game that also caught the eye. He did extremely well to hold off the attentions of Norwich’s centre-backs when receiving a pass from Ayyoub Bouaddi and then returning the ball to the Moroccan who released Rayan Cherki through to score City’s second. His movement was also sharp, at one point taking a difficult pass sweetly in an adjusted strike, only for Norwich’s Bruno Alves to come across to make a timely intervention before Samba could get his shot off.

"Was there any doubt?"Ayyoub Bouaddi with his first assist for Man City as he sets up Rayan Cherki to make it 2-0 🔵 pic.twitter.com/0gfxp5GDXy.

Industry observers note that “It was satisfying not just for the two goals but for the entire performance,” Maresca said. “He didn’t play many games as a nine but he was good. He’s young, full of energy, strong, he can finish.”.

Allan, a £34m summer signing from Palmeiras, will have been just as pleased with his contribution. Maresca’s fluid formation initially resembled a 3-1-5-1 with Allan effectively operating as a right wing-back but he stuck doggedly to the task before eventually getting the moment to showcase his quality, first with his cross for Samba and later with a neat solo run and finish.

Driving inside Sam Field and then cutting back inside the Norwich man before curling an inch perfect finish into the bottom corner – all of it done with his left foot – it was quite the introduction.

Allan on his debut! 🇧🇷Magic from the Brazilian to make it 3-0 to Man City 💥 pic.twitter.com/nw6lNqh1yL.

Hugo Viana, City’s director of football, has said supporters will need to be patient with Allan and that it may take the 22-year-old time to adjust to English football but this first outing will do his confidence plenty of good.

“It was crucial for him to play 90 minutes and to see a little bit the English competition that is a bit different from South America so overall was good,” Maresca remarked.

According to recent reports, cherki was the only survivor from the team that started Sunday’s victory over Manchester United but it all felt pretty seamless from City. Bouaddi, the £85m signing from Lille, was poised and graceful in midfield alongside the impressive Mateo Kovacic and Geronimo Rulli could not have asked for a much quieter debut in goal.

FLOYD SAMBA again!! 🌟The 17-year-old curls one in to score his second on his Man City debut with his dad Christopher watching on in the stands 👏 pic.twitter.com/fJ5mfEWBx1.

According to recent reports, nico O’Reilly looked like he had barely broken a sweat despite Norwich’s players routinely being unable to keep up with him. Norwich themselves made nine changes but the gulf in class was enormous and testament to City’s strength in depth.

The game also gave Maresca the opportunity to give run outs to two more academy graduates who played in that Youth Cup final triumph, Kaden Braithwaite and Ryan McAidoo and the latter got his own name on the scoresheet to make it 5-0.

All told there were seven City academy graduates on the pitch, two of them playing for Norwich. This was certainly a night to remember for the club’s youth production line.

Recent findings suggest that with the dominant performance, Man City have earned themselves the privilege of hosting Brighton in the next round, who will no doubt prove a much stiffer challenge than Norwich. They become the sixth all-Premier League tie in the next round, with only Fleetwood, Bradford and Peterborough remaining from outside the top flight:.

Possession: Man City 66% vs 34% Norwich.

Touches inside opposition box: 30 vs 4.

Erling Haaland left out of the squad, watching from the stands, would have enjoyed that performance from Floyd Samba. Here is his second goal for you to enjoy on his debut night:.

FLOYD SAMBA again!! 🌟The 17-year-old curls one in to score his second on his Man City debut with his dad Christopher watching on in the stands 👏 pic.twitter.com/fJ5mfEWBx1.

Five unanswered goals and a home-grown hero emerges for Manchester City!

Sources indicate that great through ball from O’Reilly, which Lewis lets run past him for the dummy. McAidoo runs on to it on the right of the box and first-time fires it low into the far corner.

It has been a perfect night for Manchester City’s academy.

According to recent reports, well we look like we’re heading for a matching scoreline to the previous edition of the fixture. That pesky shot on target is still eluding Norwich, whereas Samba is still out there looking for his hat-trick.

Two minutes of time to be added – who will get there first?

O’Reilly sends a high, looping ball to the back post from the left side, where McAidoo rushes to meet it but can’t get over it under pressure.

Final change for Norwich, as Kvistgaarden who has not had much service tonight, comes off for Schwartau.

Bouaddi sends a looping ball across the field to McAidoo, which he picks up on the edge of the box, but he is unable to get the ball under control to take his shot and it is cleared away as far as another City shirt.

The corner comes in to the centre of the box but is headed out by a City shirt.

It’s all slightly too little too late for Norwich.

They get another corner as Musaba tries to send a cross into the box from the right and it is blocked out.

Recent findings suggest that A free-kick for Norwich now as O’Reilly commits the foul 35 yards out. It goes in towards McConville at the back post, but Ait-Nouri heads it out for a Norwich corner.

Mo Touré strays just offside on the edge of the box, as Musaba sends a lovely little ball over to find him on the turn and the forward slots it past Rulli. Celebrations don’t quite begin before the flag goes up but that is a shame for the visitors.

Norwich have managed to get more of a grip in this half, despite conceding two more goals, but they are still without a shot on goal as we approach the final 15 minutes.

Another round of changes for both sides.

Man City take off scorer of their third goal Allan to bring on Braithwaite.

Norwich replace Ben Slimane and Bruno Alves with Touré and McConville.

Recent findings suggest that samba again at the heart of the action, laying off the ball to McAidoo on the right for the winger to run into the box. His shot towards the far post is saved low by Grimshaw who spills it almost into the path of Lewis, but Norwich survive.

Industry observers note that lewis makes a run down the right-hand side and crosses into Samba on the edge of the box. He lays off to McAidoo, but his shot goes sailing over the bar.

A surprise to no one, it is chucking it down in Manchester.

Massive cheers from the away end as Norwich get their first corner of the evening. It is lofted high and long to the back post, where it is headed away by Bouaddi. It bounces out to Musaba, who has just come on, and he strikes it from the top of the box on the half-volley.

His shot cuts through a crowd in the box and has Rulli diving to his left, but it goes wide of the post. What an introduction that would have been!

In a recent development, well all the stories from this match will be all about young Floyd Samba. Feel free to leave your best punny Samba/dance-related headlines in the comments section.

For Man City as you would expect it is all about game management from here on out.

Some more changes to report for Norwich as well, as Crnac is replaced by Musaba.

Wright is able to run in to space towards the edge of the box, but as has been their story all evening, his pass out to the wing is just not where it needs to be and their effort just breaks down.

What a way to score a second! A night to remember for Floyd Samba!

Industry observers note that norwich try and play out from the back but far too sloppy and Ait-Nouri picks up the ball on the left of the box. He has plenty of time to tee up Samba inside the box at the left corner, who finds himself with plenty of space to curl his shot into the far corner, beating the diving Grimshaw.

We may be seeing plenty more of him this season.

It has been revealed that norwich looking for their way back into the game, as the ball comes down the left, fizzed in low and flashes past Rulli, trying to claim it. It deflects off a crowd of bodies and spins up, but Fisher can’t connect and it spins away harmlessly wide of the goal.

It is definitely Norwich’s best chance of the game and Fisher will be upset he hasn’t made more of that.

And Allan makes it three! Minutes after the restart, the Brazilian makes his own mark on his debut.

Maresca switched him onto the left side to escape Yongwa, and he picks up the ball outside the box and makes the run inside. He runs circles around Field and slots the ball home into the far bottom corner.

Industry observers note that some changes from both sides at half-time. McAidoo comes on for Cherki, though O’Reilly is the one to move up into midfield to fill the gap.

Norwich take off Diallo for Maghoma.

45 minutes left for the visitors to create something special!

It has been revealed that what a moment for Floyd Samba! 😍A goal on his Man City debut for the 17-year-old, son of former Blackburn defender Chris 🩵 pic.twitter.com/VCVfX9HCNn.

Manchester City will be the ones to host Brighton in the next round – giving the visitors the opportunity to pull off a remarkable feat of knocking out both Manchester sides should they win.

Enjoy the highlights from last night as they came from behind to dispatch Man Utd:.

Possession: Man City 72% vs 28% Norwich.

Touches inside opposition box: 15 vs 1.

And without much ado at the end of the half, we have reached the break. City put themselves in control with two quick-fire goals and it looks a tall task for Norwich to find their way back into the match.

According to recent reports, credit where it is due, Yongwa has been very good for Norwich. He has stood fast, made some very good challenges and stopped Allan getting much of a look-in on the right.

Recent findings suggest that as we approach half-time, the stats tell a sorry story. Norwich have had just 28% possession and created a single shot, none on target.

As City come again, Norwich have pulled every man back to try and keep the situation salvageable before the break.

Sources indicate that samba was in again there, making a run into the box with a ball from Cherki, wrestling with Bruno Alves as he goes. The defender does enough to throw him off and Grimshaw is able to come out and snatch the ball.

Man City are looking to close this out now, and they look threatening every time they break.

Ait-Nouri is the latest to try his luck, making a run into the box from the left, but his shot is blocked.

A few minutes to remember here for Floyd Samba. First he steers home a very well taken header to give City the lead and then he plays a crucial role in the second, holding the ball up well before laying it off to Bouaddi to release Cherki to score. That’s how to make an impression on your debut.

In a recent development, and the floodgates have opened. Two goals in two minutes for the defending champions.

It has been revealed that samba finds Bouaddi in midfield, who takes it forward and feeds Cherki running to his left. He gets himself one-on-one and slots cool as you like into the bottom left corner.

City are in control all of a sudden and Norwich will be devastated.

As soon as I say that, Floyd Samba finds a way through.

Industry observers note that he has looked the brightest for City, and O’Reilly sends a cross over the box from the left, drawing Grimshaw away from position. The ball is pinged back in by Allan and the youngster stoops to meet it, heading in to the bottom corner.

Norwich have been very disciplined in defence so far. Yongwa has been closing down Allan on the wing very well.

Cherki is starting to get some momentum – but is swarmed by yellow shirts as he picks up the ball on the edge of the area.

Sources indicate that another loose ball from City in midfield and Norwich pick it up again. The ball to set the front line free is equally as loose from the visitors though and it breaks down once again.

According to recent reports, samba is looking lively, racing to get on a ball in front of Darling just on the edge of the box. Darling recovers to send it out for a corner, which becomes a free kick after Ait-Nouri wrestles his man to the ground at the back post as City are taking.

Wright sends a long ball across the field, looking for a man on the right side but Rulli is alert to it and comes to claim at the edge of the box.

Kovacic demonstrates some promise with a strong run on the ball down the centre of the field, taking the ball all the way to the edge of the box, where he collides with a defender, and the ball spins away for Norwich to clear out.

This is better from City, who have looked like they’re lacking drive so far.

Industry observers note that yongwa again probing down the left side. It takes two to dispossess him and Man City manage to get the throw in, but approaching 20 minutes Norwich will be happy with this.

Sources indicate that kovacic loses the ball in midfield and Norwich surge forward. The move breaks down as Wright’s pass to Diallo on the wing is just behind him and he can’t take it forward into the box.

Industry observers note that spent the first 10 minutes trying to work out City’s system and settled on a 3-1-5-1, with Bouaddi operating as a nominal third centre-back, but it seems to have changed again now with O’Reilly dropping to left back and Bouaddi stepping into midfield. No doubt the metamorphosis will continue.

This Man City team have never played all together and it is clear that they’re still settling in here, figuring out how they’re going to press here.

Kovacic in the captain’s armband is tying it all together in midfield.

Recent findings suggest that khusanov threads a lovely ball to Samba who flicks it into the path of Lewis, who takes it and makes a run into the box. He creates space and sends a right-footed shot over the bar – but Man City are building.

According to recent reports, norwich make a move forward, with Yongwa bringing the ball down the left side but his cross into the box is blocked by Allan sliding in. The Brazilian is then fouled again as Yongwa tries to reclaim the ball and Man City get back in possession.

It’s actually three Samba brothers at City. The youngest, Emerson, is also in the academy.

Early foul on Allan gets Man City a free kick and they have started as everyone expected they would – in plenty of possession.

They look for the early goal as O’Reilly feeds him in the from the left side, but the shot is blocked.

We have kicked off in Manchester!

With just over 10 minutes until kick-off here are the teams for tonight’s fixture:.

Man City XI: Rulli; O’Reilly, Vitor Reis, Khusanov, Lewis; Kovacic (c), Bouaddi; Ait-Nouri, Cherki, Allan; Samba.

Subs: Anderson, Braithwaite, Donnarumma, Fernández, Guéhi, McAidoo, Ndiaye, Matheus Nunes, Semenyo.

Norwich City XI: Grimshaw; Yongwa, Bruno Alves, Darling (c), Fisher; Field, Wright; Diallo, Ben Slimane, Crnac; Kvistgaarden.

Subs: Chrisene, Mattsson, Kovacevic, Maghoma, McConville, Musaba, Schwartau, Stacey, Touré.

"It's part of the decision that I took when I decided to join this club"Enzo Maresca responds to the doubts surrounding him filling Pep Guardiola's shoes 👇 pic.twitter.com/o6eUjQUOnU.

David 🆚 Goliath 🤝🎥 https://t.co/5YXw2tQvfX pic.twitter.com/fTp9zD0xiX.

As Abdukodir Khusanov makes his fourth start of the season, Hugo Viana, Man City director of football, has been speaking about the young Uzbek. The 22-year-old signed a upcoming five-year contract with City in July, and Viana has affirmed that he “will be one of the best centre-backs in the world”.

"Abdukodir Khusanov will be one of the best centre-backs in the world" - Hugo Viana 🇺🇿🌏Full interview 🔗 https://t.co/dk3Qi8DF8D pic.twitter.com/hHdVdX5HSF.

It’s nine changes for Norwich from the squad that lost 4-3 to Middlesbrough on the weekend.

Norwich goalkeeper Daniel Grimshaw came through the ranks at Manchester City, joining as a teenager, so this will be a special night for the 28-year-old.

It has been revealed that speaking of Phil Foden, the winger will not be making an appearance tonight, as he is serving his three-match suspension following his sending off in the Manchester derby. The England international lashed out at Bruno Fernandes after the United captain had fouled him, resulting in a red card for violent conduct.

As well as this fixture, he will also be missing City’s game against Sunderland and the trip to Anfield to face Liverpool the following weekend.

We broke down the incident as it happened on Sunday and you can get the full story here.

Heavy squad rotation (10 changes in total for Maresca) has handed debuts for Gero Rulli in goal, as well as Allan and Floyd Samba in the outfield.

17-year-old Samba is the latest from City’s academy to be making his debut in the senior squad, following in the footsteps of Phil Foden, Rico Lewis, Nico O’Reilly and many more. A versatile midfielder, he has totalled 24 appearances across six competitions (incl Premier League 2) and scored 17 and assisted six goals in those matches.

Keep your eyes on young midfielder Floyd Samba, who has been handed his Manchester City debut tonight against Norwich by manager Enzo Maresca. Floyd is the 17 year old son of former Blackburn Rovers defender Christopher Samba.

Recent findings suggest that his older brother Tyrone, 18, also plays for City. The siblings played in City’s FA Youth Cup final win over Manchester United last season, with Floyd scoring the first in a 2-1 win.

Sources indicate that city fans will also be keen to see how Allan Elias gets on on his first start, having arrived from Palmeiras for £34m. Geronimo Rulli also debuts in goal.

Checking in 🚌🚶‍♂️ pic.twitter.com/xWYGyaH7TY.

Manchester City or Norwich vs Brighton.

Ⓒ Darling with the armband🧤 Grimshaw in goal⚡️ Ante on the rightYour Yellows for this evening ⬇️ pic.twitter.com/znOGtvyJyk.

Your City side to take on Norwich 👊XI | Rulli, Lewis, Khusanov, Reis, O'Reilly, Bouaddi, Kovačić (C), Samba, Allan, Aït-Nouri, CherkiSUBS | Donnarumma, Anderson, Guéhi, Ndiaye, Fernández, Nunes, Semenyo, McAidoo, Braithwaite🤝 @etihad pic.twitter.com/LCA4WfACBf.

Good evening and welcome to another night of Carabao Cup coverage! It is the final fixture of round three (I promise) as Manchester City host Norwich.

According to recent reports, these two sides have not met since 2022, when Norwich were still in the top flight and were beaten 4-0 by City. Looking at their previous meetings, the odds are definitely stacked in favour of Enzo Maresca’s side, who have scored 14 unanswered goals in their last three meetings with Norwich, while the Championship side have not scored any.

City will be looking to make it six straight wins across all competitions tonight, having started perfectly in the Premier League with four wins from four, and comfortably seeing off Porto in their Champions League opener.

They were the talk of the weekend with their deeply controversial 1-0 win over rivals Manchester United as – having gone down to 10 men after Phil Foden was sent off – their winning goal was allowed to stand despite Enzo Fernández being clearly in an offside position that impacted United’s keeper and backline.

Erling Haaland has put Manchester City ahead in the derby after a VAR check ⚽️ pic.twitter.com/V0DCwryhFy.

City are defending their title in this competition – beating Arsenal last year in the final – but like all Premier League teams playing in European competitions, have only entered the tournament this year in the third round.

According to recent reports, philippe Clement’s side beat MK Dons 4-1 in the first round, and followed that up with a 2-1 win over Cardiff City in the second to reach the Etihad tonight. The fourth-round draw has already been done, and it has been decided that the winner of this match will face Brighton.

But we have at least 90 minutes of the third round left before that, so without further ado, we’ll get underway and bring you team updates shortly!

Le ultime dai campi e le probabili formazioni di Bologna-Udinese:.

Squadra che vince non si cambia. Ormai è questo il diktat di Raffaele Palladino, che contro l’Udinese punterà ancora una volta sui fedelissimi. In porta ancora Skorupski, che dopo gli errori di inizio stagione ha ritrovato lo smalto migliore. Anche in difesa e a centrocampo l’allenatore del Bologna ha le idee chiarissime: Darmian, Casale e Theate comporranno il terzetto difensivo, mentre in mediana la coppia Ferguson-Pobega (sempre partita dal primo minuto nella nuova gestione) si prepara a scaldare nuovamente i motori dall'inizio. Pobega viene da un riposo di quindici giorni ideale per ripartire al massimo, mentre Ferguson si prepara alla diciottesima partita tra Bologna e Scozia. Sugli esterni agiranno Zortea e Cambiaghi, al momento in vantaggio su Alhassane. Davanti Odgaard (favorito su Piccoli) sarà supportato da Bernardeschi e Orsolini. Heggem non convocato. (da Bologna, Leonardo Nevischi).

In a recent development, L’Udinese è pronta a ripartire dalla sfida contro il Bologna con chiaramente la necessità di provare a risalire la china dopo un primo terzo di campionato disastroso. Mister Paolo Zanetti recupera per la sfida Zanoli, mentre perde Bertola, in dubbio la presenza di Ebosse, rientrato acciaccato dalle sfide con la nazionale, e di Alaba, reduce dal problema al polpaccio, con anche Davis che potrebbe non essere della partita. Si va verso il 3-4-2-1 con Okoye in porta, Abankwah, Palma e Solet a comporre la linea difensiva. Sulle fasce Vojvoda e Kamara, con al centro Piotrowski e Karlstrom. Ekkelenkamp e Zaniolo andranno a supporto dell’unica punta, che potrebbe essere Bayo. (da Udine, Davide Marchiol).

Industry observers note that domani sera contro l'Atalanta dovrebbe scendere in campo un 'tridente' inedito tra le file dell'Inter: agiranno dalla parte destra infatti Benjamin Pavard, Djed Spence e Pio Esposito per la prima volta insieme in stagione. Si sofferma su questo oggi La Gazzetta dello Sport: "Una catena di destra nuova di zecca, composta da un tris di anelli brillanti e pronti a continuare a splendere o a tornare a farlo. Soggettivo, dipende dai casi. Dal rigenerato Pavard al confermato Spence, arrivando fino al gioiello Pio Esposito: per la prima volta in stagione, Cristian Chivu dovrebbe scegliere questi tre interpreti per costruire la fascia destra. Il francese nel terzetto dei difensori davanti a Martinez, l'ex Tottenham sempre più determinante a tutta fascia, Pio pronto a ricevere.

Tre uomini che mai prima di oggi hanno giocato insieme, né dall’inizio né un po' più per caso a gara in corso, se non per la manciata di minuti finale di Rotterdam quando Pavard subentrò nel finale della sfida di Champions sul campo del Feyenoord con la partita ormai in cassaforte. Poco, pochissimo, per farsi un'idea concreta. Ma abbastanza per provare a comprendere quale sia il piano tattico nella mente dell'allenatore nerazzurro per la sfida alla Dea. Se l'impiego di Pavard rappresenterebbe una novità - gradita scandagliando i pochi precedenti - non sorprenderà invece rivedere Djed Spence padrone della corsia destra. L'inglese ha ormai scavalcato Andy Diouf nelle gerarchie in corsia, garantisce meno fantasia offensiva ma più abitudine nel difendere. È stato acquistato in estate per questo (ad una cifra importante) e non è un caso che ormai partirà stabilmente avanti rispetto al francese. Davanti, a proposito di profili internazionali e graditi in Europa e nel mondo, l'Inter non può rinunciare a Pio Esposito: 5 gol nelle ultime 4 partite tra nerazzurro e Nazionale, una forma ritrovata al top, la possibilità di gestire con calma il ritorno in campo di Lautaro Martinez.

Sources indicate that comprendere come si muoverebbe sul campo una catena tutta nuova è ad oggi parecchio complesso, considerando che il campione da cui pescare spunti tattici vari lascia lo spazio della manciata di minuti di Rotterdam in cui Pavard, Spence ed Esposito si sono ritrovati in campo insieme nello stesso momento. Ma qualche certezza c'è: Pavard, nato terzino, potrà sfruttare la diligenza difensiva di Spence per uscire ed alzarsi a seconda dei momenti, e non è escluso nemmeno che in determinate fasi i due possano persino alternarsi. Il resto diventa un tema più che altro offensivo, perché se Esposito arriva da 5 gol consecutivi di cui un paio nelle ultime 2 con l'Inter, il merito va spartito proprio con Djed Spence: assist (sporcato) dell'inglese a Rotterdam per il 94 nerazzurro in Champions League e altro passaggio vincente per indirizzare rapidamente la sfida di campionato contro il Como. Un'intesa fruttuosa e in crescendo, a cui l'Inter non può rinunciare", conclude la Rosea.

The boyish, Lego-obsessed son of a farmer who quit Man City to become England's No 1: How James Trafford - with £95m spent on him - is maturing to star for Leeds and the Three Lions

📅 16 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 8 min read (1508 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Dailymail

⏱️ ~8 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Published: 14:00 EST, 16 November 2026 | Updated: 16:35 EST, 16 November 2026.
  • Sources indicate that 'It was like meeting a kid at a sixth-form careers day'.
  • When, at England's World Cup base in Kansas City, I then sat down with Trafford and he revealed that his partner had packed some Lego for him to build in camp, you wondered if sixth-form was a grade too high.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By CRAIG HOPE, CHIEF FOOTBALL REPORTER.

Published: 14:00 EST, 16 November 2026 | Updated: 16:35 EST, 16 November 2026.

Sources indicate that 'It was like meeting a kid at a sixth-form careers day'. That was the verdict, slightly unflattering but endearing all the same, of one Premier League chief after encountering James Trafford.

When, at England's World Cup base in Kansas City, I then sat down with Trafford and he revealed that his partner had packed some Lego for him to build in camp, you wondered if sixth-form was a grade too high.

According to recent reports, he is the son of a Cumbrian farmer and the Lego was of a tractor, which he would save for later in the tournament. 'You don't want to go too early,' he stated.

In a recent development, none of this is a criticism. Far from it. There was a boyish charm, an innocence, even, and Trafford was engaging company. Nonetheless, he did not sound ready for the likes of a World Cup semi-final against Argentina. Thomas Tuchel agreed.

It has been revealed that but every boy will one day become a man. On a ferocious and febrile night in Madrid, no place for adolescents, we may just have witnessed James Trafford's graduation ceremony.

Without his double save in stoppage-time, England would have left Spain without a famous, and deserved, victory. One Spanish title labelled it 'la actuacion de su vida', the performance of his life. You wonder how much they saw of his loan spell at Accrington Stanley, but the sentiment stands.

James Trafford celebrates with Jarell Quansah, Dan Burn and Ezri Konsa during his starring performance in Spain.

Trafford pictured with his farmer father, David, in the cab of his tractor with their dogs (Source: James Trafford).

Madrid daily AS exclaimed: 'Magisterio de Trafford!' Translated, 'A Trafford Masterclass!'. They claim he was the reason Spain could not complete their comeback, and they would be right.

According to recent reports, when Tuchel stood with us in a corridor of the Metropolitano Stadium on the eve of the game, he had no issue confirming that Trafford would start. His message, though, was clear - it was sink or swim for a goalkeeper who turned 24 last month.

Recent findings suggest that not only did Trafford keep his head above water, it was he who pulled the team ashore. It was he to whom his senior colleagues ran in celebration. Ezri Konsa nearly took the shirt off Trafford's back, such was the force of his gratitude. But maybe this was the occasion when Trafford took the No 1 jersey from the back of Jordan Pickford, the holder for nearly a decade.

Pickford has done nothing wrong. Were Trafford to still display that maturity deficit, Pickford would be a reliable custodian heading to Euro 2028. This is not Peter Shilton post Italia 90, an uncomfortable truth of a great in need of the retirement barn. The 32-year-old has plenty to give on the back of all he has already given.

This, admitted Tuchel after the 3-2 win, is a selection dilemma that allows a manager to sleep well at night.

According to recent reports, 'There is no headache at all!' he boomed. 'I'm so far away from a headache, I cannot imagine.

Trafford left Manchester City with the blueprint to usurp Jordan Pickford as England No 1.

Jude Bellingham certainly seemed impressed with the performance of the goalkeeper.

Recent findings suggest that 'This is what we wanted. This is the best thing that can happen to all of us, also to Pickers. It is amazing how they push each other, and if then Traff has a performance like this, he has it because he knows he's well prepared. He gets the push from his colleagues and competitors.'.

Industry observers note that tuchel has seen enough of Trafford in training and around camp to believe he is ready for promotion. He has watched him for Leeds, where he rates as the best performing goalkeeper in the Premier League. His 'net goals prevented' (4.4) and 'save percentage' (81.4) are higher than any rival this season, including Pickford.

'You always have to deserve your place,' added Tuchel. 'You will never get a gift and just get a game (for the sake of it). So he deserved to play and we expected this kind of performance. It was not only the last save, but also the build-up play and not losing focus. He has proved it on this stage, so this gives him a lot of belief. Now, it's on him to keep going for it.'.

It, you presume, is the No 1 jersey. Trafford has made no secret of his desire to take it from Pickford, and he told us in the summer that such ambition was the motivation behind him wanting to leave Manchester City for a second time.

Industry observers note that that day, he flipped his room key with a magician's sleight of hand throughout the interview, a dexterity useful for Lego. Better still for fingertip saves such as the one to deny Aymeric Laporte in the 91st minute.

Also in the gift pack from his girlfriend were two face masks. 'Very thoughtful,' he quipped. But that is another observation, bordering on concern, that some prospective buyers have made in recent years - on the goalkeeping scale of uber professional to joker, he resides too close to the latter. We have seen, even this season, the odd concentration lapse that speaks to that thought.

Trafford has played a starring role in goal since moving to Leeds United in the summer.

Sources indicate that but there was also a feeling that Trafford needed more exposure and responsibility before the penny dropped and his value was realised. Already, £95million has been spent on him in transfer fees.

Recent findings suggest that at Leeds, and now with England, he has been given that stage, as Tuchel calls it. The head coach maintains that Pickford is his first choice, but it was Trafford he picked for both Nations League fixtures against Spain, the ones that really mattered, the ones that would strengthen or threaten his own employment.

As for Trafford's career prospects, to revisit our opening line, England's No 1 sounds like a fair vocation.

Thomas Tuchel wants England to use victory in the Nations League finals as a springboard to winning Euro 2028 at Wembley.

The head coach admits it has taken him a while to recover from the trauma of his side’s World Cup semi-final defeat by Argentina in July, for which he was heavily criticised.

But after beating world champions Spain 3-2 on Sunday night, topping their Nations League group ahead of March’s quarter-finals and next summer's finals, Tuchel is finally able to look forward with positivity and belief.

‘I saw the celebrations in Portugal when they won the Nations League,’ he stated. ‘It’s just the best, the best preparation we can have for the Euros. We want to have these matches on the highest level to prove ourselves and to gain confidence, to see where we are and to adjust our game where we need to, that’s what this Nations League is perfect for. We want to win it.’.

England have won five of their six matches since the World Cup, losing only to Spain at Wembley in September. In the build up to that game, Tuchel was involved in heated exchanges with observers who continued to question his tactics in the final half hour against Argentina.

’It took me a while to digest (the World Cup exit) and see the way forward, how we can help and adjust and improve, and how we can do this together,’ he said.

Sources indicate that ‘We had reviews and so on, but clarity then came together with the players. Straight away we had the energy right to take the next steps. The ideas became more clear for me, even if it was not so easy the first week, to overcome and arrive with different emotions. Some were still upset from the World Cup. Some were fresh in the team. Some had digested it, some had not digested it. But it was crucial to have this kind of process together.

‘(Spain) was a complete performance that makes me very proud. It's a full package of belief, of courage, of commitment, of togetherness, of relying on each other and stepping up in this moment.’.

Tuchel, though, has rejected the idea that seeing out the win Madrid was proof that he has learned from his mistakes in Atlanta.

In a recent development, ‘Not at all, I think we would not have been in this situation if it was 11 against 11,’ he noted. ‘For me, it was Mexico reloaded (not Argentina). It's one man down, but what can you do? It is their strength to have ball possession, to overload and find the gaps. It just plays totally into their hands and it comes wave after wave. It felt like three hours and thirty minutes!’.

Il difensore olandese è arrivato a parametro zero dall’Union Berlino e ha firmato un contratto fino al 2029.

According to recent reports, il Borussia Monchengladbach avrebbe avviato contatti con la Lazio per Danilho Doekhi, ma al momento prevale il pessimismo sulla riuscita dell’operazione. Il difensore olandese è tra i giocatori biancocelesti finiti sotto i riflettori dopo l’avvio di campionato della squadra di Gennaro Gattuso, prima da sola in Serie A dopo undici partite.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

It has been revealed that secondo Sky Sport DE, il club tedesco ha inserito Doekhi nella propria lista dei desideri. Il Borussia è ultimo in Bundesliga e cerca rinforzi per evitare la retrocessione in seconda divisione. Il centrale conosce già il campionato tedesco: prima di arrivare alla Lazio, ha giocato per quattro stagioni nell’Union Berlino.

I contatti tra i due club sarebbero già cominciati, senza che questo renda probabile il trasferimento. La Lazio non intende privarsi facilmente del difensore mentre continua a inseguire le prime posizioni della classifica. La società dovrà inoltre confrontarsi con problemi economici che limiteranno anche il mercato invernale.

#49935. Thomas Tuchel is now embracing traditional English values - clarity has helped England understand who they are, and now they can beat the best, writes CRAIG HOPE

📅 16 Nov 2026 • ⏱️ 5m • 📚 Deep Dive (938 w)
📖 Baca
General ⚖️ Neutral 🌐 Dailymail ↗ Open Full Page

Thomas Tuchel is now embracing traditional English values - clarity has helped England understand who they are, and now they can beat the best, writes CRAIG HOPE

📅 16 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 5 min read (938 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Dailymail

⏱️ ~5 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Published: 16:57 EST, 16 November 2026 | Updated: 16:57 EST, 16 November 2026.
  • Sources indicate that thomas Tuchel has always liked what he sees from his England players on the training pitch.
  • It is why, when the squad reconvened at St George’s Park in September, Tuchel used the meeting room as much as he did the grass to address that disparity in delivery.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By CRAIG HOPE, CHIEF FOOTBALL REPORTER.

Published: 16:57 EST, 16 November 2026 | Updated: 16:57 EST, 16 November 2026.

Sources indicate that thomas Tuchel has always liked what he sees from his England players on the training pitch. Less so, at times, inside a stadium. It is a contradiction with which he has wrestled since the World Cup, when performances on the whole left him underwhelmed, save for the collective spirit and individual excellence that rescued results.

It is why, when the squad reconvened at St George’s Park in September, Tuchel used the meeting room as much as he did the grass to address that disparity in delivery.

Industry observers note that at the same time, the elephant in the corner of the auditorium was the German’s own comments about the DNA of English players compared to the likes of Spain, and fundamentally them lacking the coding to protect possession and, therefore, valuable leads. He asked Harry Kane, Jude Bellingham and others for their thoughts.

According to recent reports, the message back from his players was this – let us be better at being us, not them. Interestingly, that was Tuchel’s mantra upon his appointment, one of embracing traditional English values. Amid the World Cup fallout, though, he had wandered in a daze down a rabbit hole of genetics, focusing on what his team cannot do as opposed to what they can.

In a recent development, tuchel, his staff and his players are tacticians and technicians, not scientists. If the intricacies of DNA do not allow them to be Spain, then don’t be. Be England, they determined. That is not to say kick and rush, bark and bite. After all, Kane is officially the best player in the world right now and Bellingham, unofficially, is playing as well as anyone on the planet.

Rather, there needed to be clarity – this is what we are and this is how we beat the best. On Sunday night in Madrid, England beat the very best. It was a victory born from those hours on the training field and in conference, and even more spent by Tuchel and his assistant Anthony Barry during their post-tournament review in a St George’s Park war room. They knew then that this was not a case of rip it up and start again, more so mend the tears and give the likes of Bellingham a blank sheet to impact where, and how, he sees best.

Thomas Tuchel is embracing England's DNA and reaping the rewards following the World Cup.

England can now beat the best, which they indicated against Spain in a fantastic victory.

According to recent reports, there was no radical strategical change, but there was a new doctrine, principles that should underpin whatever the in-game circumstance – off-the-ball running, a high press, filling in for a team-mate who has seized a moment to improvise elsewhere, such as the full backs. Ben White scoring England’s third on Sunday and Lewis Hall completing four more dribbles than Lamine Yamal were examples of Tuchel’s allowance for greater intuition. Be you, not Spain.

According to recent reports, kane, informally at least, has also been promoted beyond captain, a bridge between management and dressing-room. To see him in a semi-coaching and cajoling capacity on the touchline after he was taken off in the 78th minute against Spain was to witness this elevation.

According to recent reports, but even if England had conceded a late equaliser at the Metropolitano Stadium, it would not have mattered. Not when it comes to measuring post World Cup improvement. To have drawn comparison with Argentina and that second-half collapse would have been unfair and inaccurate. The semi-final was 11 versus 11 and so let us judge this game on the same terms. And what did England do with a 1-0 lead and 11 players? They attacked. And attacked again. For all of the tweaks Tuchel and Barry have made to the structure of training and the team’s set-up, this was evidence of them learning from a mistake, as much as the head coach will be loath to admit.

Ezri Konsa, however, did reveal there was a definite instruction to keep attacking Spain when Tuchel addressed the team at half-time.

‘The instruction was to keep going at them,’ said the defender. ‘Don’t stop. To keep our foot on the pedal. That is what we did. Argentina was different, different circumstances. But it was not just half-time. We went 1-0 up and Harry, our captain, told us to keep going and to keep our foot on the pedal too.'.

In a recent development, before Jarell Quansah’s needless mistake and Elliot Anderson’s subsequent dismissal in the 63rd minute, the game was not in the balance in any way. As a live observer of almost every Tuchel match since his arrival, this was the best performance of his reign. In fact, it’s not even close.

And yet, so much still comes back to Bellingham. England would not have won without him. He terrified Spain, perhaps given their intimate knowledge of his powers. Beating the best is as much a mental challenge as it is physical, and Bellingham believed. He made England believe, too. His swagger. His majesty. And yes, his skill. He won the corner for Konsa’s headed second and created the third for White. He then dropped into midfield when down to ten and battled and organised like a captain.

Bellingham has bought into the collective under Tuchel and, with that, his team-mates are buying into his big ideas. For now, they don’t come much bigger than what England achieved in Madrid.

Mi aspettavo che lottasse per un posto tra le prime cinque, ma certamente non avrei immaginato di vederla in testa alla classifica della Serie A a questo punto del campionato».

It has been revealed that L’esterno ha iniziato la stagione in modo convincente. Per Bech, se manterrà questo rendimento, potrà disputare la migliore annata della sua carriera. Thomas Tuchel faces fight to win trust of England players
